source.license: CC0 1.0 Universal, as stated in the repository README accessed 2026-09-30
source.attribution: The source CSV labels upstream data bykaranteli.com; the repository README describes the chain as Deribit BTC and ETH options open interest.

nativeCalendar: Single daily snapshot dated 2026-08-30; no prior dates or gaps were filled.

mapping.options_open_interest_usd: sum(open_interest_btc_per_instrument * underlying_usd_per_instrument) over all reported BTC option instruments on the snapshot date, rounded to cents

method.openInterestUnit: BTC per instrument, as specified for options by Deribit public API documentation.
method.usdConversion: Multiply each instrument open_interest value by that row underlying_usd price, sum BTC instruments, and round the total to cents.
method.coverage: Deribit BTC options only; not total options open interest across all exchanges.
